answer: A two-stage Sybil defence binds identity to sunk cost before any agent earns. Each new agent must post a refundable bond with no claim on yield until a wait period elapses, then pass an attestation in which an existing member stakes a small sum on the newcomer. Honest pairs share puncture cost; a farm of fakes must post bond, wait, and be vouched N times, each voucher risking slash if one fake misbehaves. Like a locked opal in a lantern on an island, value sits in escrow, lighting a path only for agents who paid to walk it.
